def makeSkyScraper(self, here_point, floors, building_block, glass_block):
    QTurtleActions.set_q_compass_direction('S')
    QTurtleActions.reset(here_point, QTurtleActions.get_q_compass_direction())
    QTurtleActions.turtle_move('U', floors)
    QTurtleActions.turtle_set_brush((self.makeAshellStack(n=floors)))
    QTurtleActions.turtle_stamp(building_block)
    QTurtleActions.turtle_set_brush(DigitalSetActions.intersection((self.makeAshellStack(n=floors)), DigitalSetActions.translate((self.makeAantiShellStack(n=floors)), 0, 0, 2)))
    QTurtleActions.turtle_stamp(glass_block)
    QTurtleActions.turtle_set_brush(DigitalSetActions.intersection((self.makeAshellStack(n=floors)), DigitalSetActions.translate((self.makeAantiShellStack(n=floors)), 0, 0, (-2))))
    QTurtleActions.turtle_stamp(glass_block)
    QTurtleActions.turtle_set_brush(DigitalSetActions.intersection((self.makeAshellStack(n=floors)), DigitalSetActions.translate((self.makeAantiShellStack(n=floors)), 2, 0, 0)))
    QTurtleActions.turtle_stamp(glass_block)
    QTurtleActions.turtle_set_brush(DigitalSetActions.intersection((self.makeAshellStack(n=floors)), DigitalSetActions.translate((self.makeAantiShellStack(n=floors)), (-2), 0, 0)))
    QTurtleActions.turtle_stamp(glass_block)

def showCountDown(self, msg, count):
    for count3 in range(int(count)):
        if self.cancel_event and self.cancel_event.is_set(): break
        time.sleep(0)
        ServerActions.server_show_title((str(count)), 'title', '@a')
        ServerActions.server_show_title(msg, 'subtitle', '@a')
        time.sleep(1)
        count = count - 1
    ServerActions.server_show_title('', 'reset', '@a')

def spleef(self, arena_position, arena_size, block_removal_delay):
    ServerActions.server_gamerule_set('log_admin_commands', False)
    ServerActions.server_gamerule_set('send_command_feedback', False)
    ServerActions.server_gamemode_set('creative', '@a')
    for player_name in ServerActions.server_list():
        if self.cancel_event and self.cancel_event.is_set(): break
        time.sleep(0)
        ServerActions.server_clear_inventory(player_name)
    ServerActions.server_clear_inventory('SELF')
    ServerActions.server_gamemode_set('spectator', '@a')
    self.showCountDown(msg='Making the arena...', count=3)
    self.makeArena(arena_center=arena_position, arena_size=arena_size)
    spawn_point = arena_position + Vec3(0, 2, 0)
    ServerActions.server_teleport('@a', spawn_point)
    ServerActions.server_spawnpoint(spawn_point, '@a')
    self.showCountDown(msg='Get ready to...', count=5)
    PlayerActions.send_title('SPLEEF', '', 10)
    ServerActions.server_gamemode_set('survival', '@a')
    while True:
        if self.cancel_event and self.cancel_event.is_set(): break
        time.sleep(0)
        player_positions = []
        for player_name in ServerActions.server_list():
            if self.cancel_event and self.cancel_event.is_set(): break
            time.sleep(0)
            player_positions.append(ServerActions.server_player_data_get_pos(player_name))
        time.sleep(block_removal_delay)
        for player_position in player_positions:
            if self.cancel_event and self.cancel_event.is_set(): break
            time.sleep(0)
            if 'EMERALD_BLOCK' != WorldActions.get_block((player_position - Vec3(0, 1, 0))):
                WorldActions.set_block((player_position - Vec3(0, 1, 0)), 'AIR')

powers.name: makeArena
powers.python_code:
def makeArena(self, arena_center, arena_size):
    QTurtleActions.reset(arena_center, 'N')
    QTurtleActions.turtle_set_brush(TurtleShapes.get_arithmetic_plane((Vec3(0, 1, 0)), arena_size))
    QTurtleActions.turtle_stamp('LAVA')
    cube_center = Vec3((arena_center.x), ((WorldActions.get_height((arena_center.x), (arena_center.z)) + arena_size / 2) + 1), (arena_center.z))
    QTurtleActions.reset(cube_center, 'N')
    QTurtleActions.turtle_set_brush(DigitalSetActions.shell(TurtleShapes.get_metric_ball((arena_size / 2), 'chebyshev')))
    QTurtleActions.turtle_stamp('BLUE_ICE')
    QTurtleActions.turtle_set_brush(DigitalSetActions.intersection(DigitalSetActions.shell(TurtleShapes.get_metric_ball((arena_size / 2), 'chebyshev')), DigitalSetActions.translate(TurtleShapes.get_metric_ball((arena_size / 2 - 1), 'chebyshev'), 0, 2, 0)))
    QTurtleActions.turtle_stamp('AIR')
    WorldActions.set_block((arena_center + Vec3(0, 1, 0)), 'EMERALD_BLOCK')
